title: Mixed Event — To You, My Caring Companion — Episode3 Welcome To The Bridal Fair!

meta.Episode: Episode3 — Welcome To The Bridal Fair!
meta.Event Outline: Honami notices that Kanade has been more focused than ever on composing lately. When Emu gives her tickets to a bridal fair, Honami decides to invite Kanade in the hope of her employer taking a break.

rows.Line: The day of the fair
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's almost time for the others to arrive.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I didn't want to be late, and ended up coming a little too early...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Anyway, Ms. Yoisaki and her friend should be...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is.
Thank you for waiting, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's okay.
I just arrived not long ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, is the person you invited already here...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm not sure.
I received a message saying that they're almost here...
Oh, there they are! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade! And this is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Honami Mochizuki, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I've mentioned you in conversation to everyone a few times already.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena has too!
I've heard all about how nice a person you are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
I feel a little embarrassed now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! But it's really nice to finally meet you after hearing everyone's stories!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I still haven't introduced myself.
I'm Mizuki Akiyama. I'm in the same music group as Kanade and mainly work as the video editor.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I've also heard your name in passing. It's nice to meet you, and I hope we have fun today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, same!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, also... Thanks for letting me tag along today! I've actually had my eye on this fair for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, a friend gave me this ticket...
Also, I'm glad that you decided to join us since it's always fun to go to these things as a group.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Akiyama...?
Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nothing's wrong!
I was just thinking that you really are a super nice person, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...? R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes, really!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade, I hope you know how lucky you are to be in the care of such a nice girl.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh...? I, um...
I'm sorry. I do appreciate everything you do, but that might not have come across properly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, don't say that! I know that you do...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You do?
Then, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, looks like the bus is here.
Let's hop on!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. This fair's going to be so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it is!
Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa...! So this is a bridal fair!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, there's so many people...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And it's not just couples here.
I'm also seeing a lot of families and groups of friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It looks like a fun event for all ages.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It certainly does.
Now, where should we begin?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on this map, the dress exhibit is straight ahead... To the left is all the accessory shops...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey! They even have a wedding hall that you can check out! I'd love to see that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's so much to do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and every booth also seems to have quite a lot to offer. It may be difficult to see everything in one day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. You two have until this evening, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, since I'm also scheduled to work today. I plan to head over to Ms. Yoisaki's house this evening after spending the day here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, instead of trying to see everything in the time we have, we should probably prioritize the things we really wanna check out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, where do you two wanna go?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll leave this up to you two since I haven't really read up on this fair.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There are a couple places I'd like to go, but the map says they're pretty far from here... So, Akiyama, why don't we start with what you'd like to see?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?! Thanks!
Then, mind if we check out the dress exhibit first?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: On top of the dresses made by famous designers, they have some that were made by amateurs who did well in their contest. I really wanna see those!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, wedding dresses...
I've never seen one up close before, so that could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, shall we?
Booth Area - Dress Exhibit

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I don't believe it! This is so awesome!
Look at all these dresses on display...! And they're all absolutely gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's hard not to be overwhelmed by how glamorous they are when you're this close.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. I get what you mean!
I mean, check out the skirt on this one!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The skirt?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's called a princess cut.
These are the kinds of dresses with super fluffy skirts that you see a lot in fairy tales! And the bow on the back of this one is so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's so big.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?! Oh, this one's a pantsuit dress! Talk about trendy! And the lace on the back's so detailed!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it even has slits!
I really like that. It gives it more of a mature feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Akiyama seems to be enjoying this very much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki likes cute clothing a lot. Just looking at that excitement makes me glad I was able to invite an extra friend.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry, you two...!
I sort of don't know what to do with myself...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I understand how you feel since I also occasionally make my own clothes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You do?! So do I!
We could totally be sewing buddies!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I have a feeling that you two would get along really well. On the other hand, I don't really understand the appeal of dresses...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, Kanade, don't say that!
I really want you to see how amazing these wedding dresses are too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! It'd involve me talking a lot, but what if I commentate as we walk around? That might make things more fun!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, sure...
That might really help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! Then, let's start with the skirt on this mermaid dress! It's called that because...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They had so many dresses just in that one exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, and I learned so much.
It was fun having you explain each one, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really? That's great to hear!
Well, there's a bunch of other stuff left to check out, so wanna head over to our next stop?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
These must be the accessory shops...
They have tiaras, bracelets, necklaces...
And they're all so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you can even try them on.
Kanade, let's see how this tiara looks on you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, me...? Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
It looks so pretty on you, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She's right! You don't dress up enough, Kanade! So, since we're here, try on this necklace! And this bracelet!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, but...
Oh, they're so heavy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Don't worry! They look amazing on you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You'd probably look like a real princess if you were to put one of those dresses on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That workshop was so much fun!
And we got to make these matching bracelets!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you both for helping me with the tricky parts. Mine wouldn't have turned out this well if you hadn't.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Honami deserves most of the credit.
I saw you had nimble fingers, but you also did a really great job of explaining what to do. You were like everyone's favorite kindergarten teacher.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
R-Really...?
That might be because I actually taught kindergarten for a day. Anyway, I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hm? What's going on over there?
A lot of people seem to be gathering...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... That seems to be the fashion show for wedding dresses and tuxedos. How about we go take a quick look since we're here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
This is way too much fun!
And we haven't even covered half of it! Talk about an amazing fair!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, every booth had such interesting things to see.
Where should we go ne—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Is she starting to get tired...?
We have been walking nonstop since this morning. Also, Ms. Yoisaki isn't particularly fond of crowds...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. The corner for the bouquet exhibit's supposed to be around here somewhere. I was hoping to take a look at it, so would it be okay if we went there next?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ooh, I wanna check it out too!
How about you, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... Sure...
Bouquet Exhibit

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, these are so pretty...!
They've got so many different types too. Round, oval and even wreaths!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, not only that...
It smells very nice here somehow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It must be all the fresh-cut flowers.
The roses, the lilies of the valley... So many gentle fragrances all mixing together. It's very soothing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely! And there aren't that many people here, probably since this exhibit's way in the back. We can relax here for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We saw so much. It's almost noon, so let's find a place where we can sit and have lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you know if there's anywhere good around here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, there's a nice-looking cafe right by this event center. Rumor has it that the food's very good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nice! Honami with the good intel!
Alright, let's go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And after we've had a filling lunch, let's get right back to it and make the most of our afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
